answer: An farming party hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The forge schedule is applied in nadir and fable makes public each instalment. A payout is split which means 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2592 identities would post 4672 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
